name: k8s node MemoryPressure — a cluster node reports the MemoryPressure condition
description: Fires, per k8s.node.name, when MAX(k8s.node.condition_memory_pressure) over the trailing 10 min is above 0: the kubelet has declared MemoryPressure and is evicting or about to evict pods. Emitter: k8s_cluster on the poweredge-xubuntu collector (thewoolleyman/otel-collector config.ci-runner-host.yaml). Runbook: open the 'Kubernetes node load' board; ssh <node>; mpstat 5 3; free -g; kubectl describe node <node>; kubectl get pods -A -o wide --field-selector spec.nodeName=<node>. Plan kubernetes-node-observability (livespec-dev-tooling-dfdiil), item livespec-dev-tooling-uftb4o.
